notes: READ IN FULL 20 September 2026 (evening) from the author's PDF, 57 pages; single author, Professor Emeritus, Kanazawa Gakuin University; no date on the title page, DataCite says 2026-09-12. It says of itself that it substantially revises the January and July manuscripts and removes their conjectural assumptions and broader hypotheses. CONTENTS: Theorem 4.5 the bijection Phi : U(d) -> J(d+1) (July Theorem 3.3); Theorem 6.1 the 2-adic valuation formula (July 5.2); Theorem 7.3 the logarithmic rate log_2 W(d) = gamma d + O(log d), gamma = 1.505644, c = 0.079319 (July 6.3), Section 7.5 noting that only the logarithmic rate is determined; Conjecture 9.1 W(d) = Theta(d^(-3/2) 2^(gamma d)) (July 7.1), 'motivated only by the numerical data and not used in any proof', with Table 4 the same four rows as July's Table 3 and Section 9.5 saying the exponent 3/2 has no theoretical derivation there; equation (48) X(d) = 2N(k_d - 1) - N(k_d), k_d = ceil(lambda d), which is Paper B's minimal-certificate identity M = 2N_(d-1) - N_d in the weight indexing, in print; Section 9 identifies N(k) = A076227(k), X(d) = A100982(d), W(d) = A100982(d+1), records the extension of A076227, A100982 and A260591 and the registration of A398447 and A398473, and Section 9.6 says those three are dropping-time sequences of integer trajectories, different objects. WHAT IT DROPS relative to the July text: Remark 6.6's claim that no asymptotic formula existed, Remark 6.5's length-basis analogue, and the Section 7.3 sentence on the fractional part of lambda d; what remains of that is Open Problem 1, that a sharper analysis of the constrained walk would need to account for the irrational slope of the critical boundary and the terminal distance from it. No oscillation, no almost-periodicity, no prefactor beyond the conjecture; Lagarias 1985 cited for the residue-class framework, not for Theorem D; Winkler's Proposition 8 credited for the counting identity; Bařina 2025 cited for verification to 2^71. Acknowledgments: generative AI for English prose, notation consistency and organisation. VERIFIED HERE: Table 4's four rows recompute exactly from the laboratory's counts (tests/research/juggler_sequence/test_hikawa_tables.py); over every d in 100 <= d <= 10000 the residual against -(3/2) log_2 d spans 0.518 bits, so the 'suggestive' agreement of Section 9.5 rests on four samples of a function that swings twice as far. Paper B's Section 6 and reference 17 cite it from the text since the 20 September evening edition.
